entries.title: Layers of Fear

emulation.notes: Use the native 2023 PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC presentation with scalable settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The 2023 Unreal Engine 5 release is the best route for the first Layers of Fear because it combines the original game, its Inheritance DLC, revised/additional narrative content, and the series-wide Writer framing in a higher-fidelity PC package.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Layers of Fear (2023) on Steam and play the Painter story and Inheritance content there. Use the 2016/Legacy versions only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2023 version is a remake/series compilation, not a simple remaster. It combines the first game, DLC, sequel material, and new connective chapters in Unreal Engine 5.

entries.title: Layers of Fear 2

emulation.notes: Use the native 2023 PC release for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC presentation with scalable settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The 2023 Layers of Fear release is the best route for Layers of Fear 2 because it rebuilds and integrates the Actor story with all released DLC and new connective chapters in a higher-fidelity Unreal Engine 5 PC package.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Layers of Fear (2023) on Steam and play the Actor story there. Use the 2019 standalone only for historical comparison.

entries.remaster_caveats: The 2023 version is a remake/series compilation that includes Layers of Fear 2 material and new connective chapters rather than a simple port.

entries.title: Layers of Fear

emulation.notes: Use the native 2023 PC Deluxe Edition for capture.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native Unreal Engine 5 PC presentation with scalable settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC Deluxe Edition is the best route for the 2023 Layers of Fear compilation because it contains the base anthology game plus digital artbook and soundtrack, with the strongest capture/display flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Layers of Fear Deluxe Edition on Steam and play the 2023 anthology release from the Windows PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is the 2023 Unreal Engine 5 anthology/remake entry combining prior stories, DLC, and new chapters; it is distinct from the 2016 game with the same title.
